module: Profile sweep: open 2D strips (lateral y, height z) are swept along a sequence of stations each carrying its own frame, to produce a single mesh per material. Unlike deckSweep, the frame is supplied by the caller (banked binormal and normal of a road), so the section rotates with the road. Stations are decimated according to a chord tolerance on the center and two key points of the section (meshRefine.decimateStations).
notes: UVs are {arc length of station s, curvilinear abscissa along the strip}.

at.desc: World point of section point (y, z) at station a: a.pos + a.b * y + a.n * z.

a.desc: Station with x,y,z, bx,by,bz (transverse vector) and nx,ny,nz (up vector).

build.desc: Sweeps the strips along the stations. Each station: { x,y,z, bx,by,bz (transverse), nx,ny,nz (up), s (abscissa) }. Each strip: { pts = {{y,z},...}, nrm = {{ny,nz},...} (unit normals toward the visible face), mat }. The quadrilateral faces are generated by meshPart.face4n.

opts.desc: { tol, tolZ, maxSeg } for decimation, keyL and keyR = watched section points {y,z}.

returns.desc: Parts (one per material); nil if fewer than 2 stations.
